section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section summarizes the development and psychometric evaluation of the BAS-2 across three studies involving college and online community women and men from the U.S. It highlights the improvements of the BAS-2 over the original BAS, its adaptive properties, and its inverse relationship with BMI. Study 2 specifically examined mean differences in BAS-2 scores between college and community women and men, noting age and BMI as partial explanatory factors for some differences.
